findings.summary: Field name suggests the continuation parent, but it is the parent of the run that produced the candidate. Continuation parent is checkpoint_sha256 e2c8fbe4.
findings.failure_scenario: A continuation registration that resolves its parent by the name candidate_parent_checkpoint_sha256 loads 0b5cf72 (update 276) instead of e2c8fbe4 (update 300). It then discards the 24 selected updates and its counters (324 vs 348) and clock baseline (4760 vs 5190) would be wrong.
findings.fix: Before the continuation is registered, add an explicit continuation_parent_checkpoint_sha256 = e2c8fbe4 and state the parent-of-run field meaning in the schema. Do not rely on the name alone.

findings.summary: The checkpoint sidecar still says training ineligible. The candidate receipt grants continuation and says checkpoint_metadata_unchanged=true, so the two disagree.
findings.failure_scenario: A preflight that reads only the sidecar rejects the authorized continuation. This fails closed, so it is not an unsafe acceptance, but it blocks the next run or invites an ad hoc override.
findings.fix: Continuation preflight must gate on retained-best-candidate-receipt.json (sha ccc73fbc) plus parent terminal receipt d64d0f80, not the sidecar. Document this in the continuation registration.

findings.summary: The run's own phase-276 checkpoint (sha 165ae5c5) differs from the parent 0b5cf72b that the receipts cite. entry-restoration.json shows model, Adam, and RNG matched the parent. The 276 row in full-audit.json is 165ae5c5 with mean 2483.65625, the same mean as the parent in D2-retained204 retained-best-selection.json.
findings.failure_scenario: A reader auditing the 276 incumbent sees two different 276 shas and cannot tell which one the 300 lineage descends from. No selection outcome changes because the eval means match.
findings.fix: Name 165ae5c5 as the phase-276 re-save of parent 0b5cf72 in the candidate receipt or completed-iteration receipt, with the entry-restoration evidence hash.

findings.summary: The future baseline (5190.21) equals the prior discarded-branch highwater 4760.062 plus 430.147, not the parent saved point 4740.377 plus 430.147 (about 19.685 s more). The receipt has three candidate clocks (5190.21 trajectory, 8621.34 completed campaign cost, 1502.56 observed outer) and no field saying which one the next registration's budget charges.
findings.failure_scenario: The next registration charges its 1800 s limit against the wrong base, for example 8621.34 instead of 5190.21, and fails a budget it should pass, or the reverse. The 5190.21 choice is conservative and matches registration resource_estimate retained_parent_future_branch_high_water_seconds, so this is a clarity issue, not a bad number.
findings.fix: Add an explicit continuation_budget_base_seconds field (expected 5190.209660791156) and state that the monotonic outer cap applies to the new run only.

no_blocking_defect_reason: All cited hashes, counters, wall arithmetic, selection, and lease state match actual closed JSON and files. The four findings are documentation or field-semantics gaps. None changes the accepted selection or the authority scope.
